subject: FinPartner evidence: VM cadence, patch rollforward & signed attestation
messages:
From: Rachel Vaughn <security@finpartner.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence bundle for VM cadence + patch proof (FinPartner SOC2)

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the time earlier. As part of our SOC 2 readiness review we need a small evidence bundle showing Redwood's vulnerability management tempo and proof that recent critical CVEs affecting our tenant were remediated within your published SLAs. Specifically we need the following: 

- A short description of the authenticated/internal scan cadence (tools, frequency, scope).
- A representative scan output (CSV) from the week of Aug 20 showing the findings you used to drive remediations for FinPartner resources.
- Patch rollforward logs or deployment notes showing the fix for CVE-2027-12345 and CVE-2027-23456 (or confirmation they were mitigated).
- A signed attestation from an owner confirming the remediation SLA was met for criticals (dates and JIRA references preferred).

If you can deliver by end of day Aug 28 (PST) that would keep us on schedule. Monica, please loop Ben if we need engineering artifacts or runbooks.

Thanks,
Rachel Vaughn
Security Program Manager
FinPartner
security@finpartner.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Vaughn <security@finpartner.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evidence bundle for VM cadence + patch proof (FinPartner SOC2)

Hi Rachel —

Appreciate the clear list. Attached are the artifacts you requested (see attachment stubs below). Summary of contents and the relevant SLA mappings are included inline so you can reference them in your SOC 2 packet.

Attachments included (zipped for delivery):
- vm_scan_batch_20270820.csv (representative authenticated scan output for the week of Aug 20; includes host and cloud-tag mapping for FinPartner tenant)
- patch_rollforward_20270822.tar.gz (deployment logs and manifest for the Aug 22 rollforward that included fixes for the two listed CVEs)
- attestation_sofia_20270827.pdf (signed attestation PDF)

Summary (high level):
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated internal network + container image scans (Nessus/Trivy) + daily lightweight cloud misconfig scans for all production accounts. Criticals are prioritized immediately.
- Triage SLA: initial triage 72 hrs for critical severity; assignment to owner within 24 hrs of triage.
- Fix/patch SLA: aim to deploy fixes for critical CVEs within 14 calendar days from discovery for in-house components; where vendor/third-party patching is required we track and document exceptions with expected ETA.

CVE mappings / JIRA references included in patch_rollforward manifest (excerpt):
- CVE-2027-12345 -> RED-8271 (patched on 2027-08-22; patch manifest entry #5)
- CVE-2027-23456 -> RED-8294 (mitigated via configuration change and image rebuild; deployed 2027-08-22; manifest entry #7)

Attestation (text excerpt included inside attestation_sofia_20270827.pdf):
"I, Sofia Ivanova, Director, Security Compliance at Redwood Inference, attest that the fixes for CVE-2027-12345 and CVE-2027-23456 impacting FinPartner-scoped resources were deployed in accordance with Redwood's vulnerability management SLAs. The deployments are documented in the attached patch_rollforward_20270822.tar.gz and are linked to JIRA entries RED-8271 and RED-8294. 

Signed: Sofia Ivanova
Date: 2027-08-27"

Notes and caveats:
- The csv is redacted for PII and includes host tags so you can map to your tenant.
- If you need raw syslog traces or OCI image digests, Ben can provide those artifacts under an NDA if required.

Monica/Ben: I copied you for engineering artifacts—Ben, can you confirm the image digest for RED-8294 when you have a moment?

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
From: Victor Lee <vlee@finpartner.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Vaughn <security@finpartner.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evidence bundle for VM cadence + patch proof (FinPartner SOC2)

Thanks Sofia — we got the ZIP and the attestation PDF. Quick follow-up: can you confirm the JIRA mapping you provided (RED-8271) covers the public CVE ID CVE-2027-12345 (the naming in the CSV is slightly different) and whether the patch was applied to resources in the us-west-2 tenancy? Also, can you share the exact image digest for RED-8294 so we can validate the image in our registry?

Thanks,
Victor Lee
Security Engineer
FinPartner
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Victor Lee <vlee@finpartner.com>, Rachel Vaughn <security@finpartner.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 10:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: evidence bundle for VM cadence + patch proof (FinPartner SOC2)

Hi Victor —

Confirming: RED-8271 is the internal tracking ticket that corresponds to remediation for the public CVE-2027-12345; the manifest maps the external CVE to the internal ticket ID. The Aug 22 deployment targeted the us-west-2 tenancy for FinPartner resources and the patch markers are present in the attached rollforward manifest (manifest entry #5).

Image digest for RED-8294: sha256:3b2f6a1d9e8c8a5d4f9b6e7c2a1f4d6b8c9e2f1a0b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7 (this digest is also recorded in the manifest and in RED-8294).

If you need a signed checksum file or a short runbook run-through for your auditors, Ben can schedule a 30-minute session early next week.

Thanks,
Sofia
Director, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference
